name: Sakaki Touya
source:
A close friend of Kaoru's, he enjoys the freedom sharing an apartment with two friends affords. He doesn't have a girlfriend, and is a virgin, like Kaoru. He has a rock band that specializes in doing covers of others' music. Band practice doesn't leave him much time for girls, despite the love letters he gets at school.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yin-Yang!_X-Change_Alternative]Wikipedia[/url] and game manual]
